subject: chemistry_2
question_text: What are anti fertility drugs? Give examples.

verification.note: The 1+1 mark split is a CLAIM, not the board's, until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced, not invented. Unit 14 (Chemistry in Everyday Life) is sourced from the chemistry half of "FAST TRACK IPE for Sr. Students", book pp.105-106, printed chapter "11. CHEMISTRY IN EVERYDAY LIFE"; the book prints this question on book p.105 as VSAQ 9. Neither the two-book union check nor a board back-test was possible for Chemistry-II: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material on hand is physics-only and first-year, and no second-year chemistry paper is in the corpus. BOOK GAP (book p.105, VSAQ 9): the printed answer gives "Norethindrone, Ethynylestradiol. Etc." with no statement of what either compound is. Norethindrone is a synthetic derivative of progesterone and ethynylestradiol, also called novestrol, is a synthetic derivative of oestrogen, and a birth control pill is a mixture of the two. Those facts are added, because without them the two names are only spellings to memorise and the examiner's follow-up question cannot be answered.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The definition
lines: They are synthetic compounds that change
the balance of the natural hormones.
steps.why: The mark is for saying what the drug prevents and how. Preventing pregnancy names the use; changing the hormone balance names the way it works, and it is the sentence that leads into the two examples.
common_mistakes: Writing that an antifertility drug ends a pregnancy. It prevents one from starting.
Leaving out the word synthetic. The drugs are made in a laboratory, not taken from the body.
steps.memory_tip: Anti plus fertility: synthetic hormones used to prevent pregnancy.
steps.margin_note: Write prevent pregnancy and the word hormones. Both together finish this mark.

steps.label: Examples and what they are
lines: A birth control pill contains both.
steps.why: The two examples are not two drugs of the same kind. One is a progesterone derivative and the other an oestrogen derivative, and a pill contains the two together because the pair is what changes the hormone balance. Writing which parent hormone each comes from is the line that finishes the answer.
common_mistakes: Writing that norethindrone is an oestrogen derivative. It comes from progesterone; ethynylestradiol comes from oestrogen.
Giving only one example when the question says give examples. Both names are short and both should be written.
steps.memory_tip: One from progesterone, one from oestrogen, and the pill contains both.
steps.margin_note: Both names are wanted here because the question says examples. Naming the parent hormone secures the mark.

insider_note: Two names alone usually earn the mark, but the follow-up question is what each one is. Write that norethindrone comes from progesterone and ethynylestradiol from oestrogen; it costs one line.
